The '''Wellspring of Life''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located somewhere "in the heart of the galaxy," the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to the [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]]. Its surface appeared barren and heavily damaged, but life was plentiful in large open spaces deep beneath the ground. Large amounts of light were released from within the planet, which was hidden in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and also appeared to negatively affect mechanical and electronic devices.

==History==
Near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] sent [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to the planet so that he could learn how to preserve his consciousness after death from the [[Force Priestesses/Legends|Force Priestesses]].<ref name="Destiny" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet appears during the Yoda arc of the [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.
